fields.summary: The district's Oakland Adult and Career Education program is approving a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Fremont Unified School District's adult school to deliver the BankWork$ program, which trains adults for jobs in the financial industry. The agreement costs the district nothing. The attached MOU takes effect on its last signature, January 23, 2020, and runs through December 31, 2020; the agenda text misprints the start year as 2022.

20-0025.sourceIssue: The text gives the start date as January 23, 2022, after the December 31, 2020 end date; the attached MOU takes effect on its January 23, 2020 signing and runs through December 31, 2020.
